That is about 12% of the 72,169,594 shares outstanding on 2026-07-31 (10-Q cover). Source: https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/AMTX/short-interest?assetclass=stocks. That data is about 3.5 weeks old, and FINRA publishes about 8 business days after settlement, so the position carried into this fall is not observable. findings.finding: Aemetis has a live at-the-market program with H.C. Wainwright (amended Feb 2025, up to $210M). It sold 2.6M shares for $7.1M in Q2 2026 and 5.2M in 1H26, about 41k shares a session or roughly 5% of ADV. It can keep selling into the 2026-09-25 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is a continuous seller that the issuer can draw on 09-25 without any new filing. Any bounce off a two-day, -15% slide on ordinary volume meets issuer supply at an agent that has sold every quarter this year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM has run through the whole comparable-fall history in the baseline (123 events, median -0.37% next close). Its effect is already inside that median rather than separable from it.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall priced whatever was learned (nothing identifiable) but not the fact that the issuer is a standing seller. A price that held it would show no rebound on the low-volume, no-news pattern where phase 0 measured +1.46%. This finding says to expect about the stock's own flat-to-negative median instead. It is small because the draw rate is about 5% of volume and has run for months.
